verdict.rationale: The pack has no published TFLOPS or TOPS figure at any precision and never states sparsity. The only performance claims are relative marketing multiples ('3X the training performance and 15X the inference performance'), which is exactly the bare-number pattern the story rejects. Memory capacity (1,440 GB) and NVLink bandwidth (14.4 TB/s) are adjacent specs, not tensor throughput, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can size training and inference from published tensor throughput — TFLOPS or TOPS with precision and sparsity stated, not a bare marketing number
